cases.state: seeded fixture; setup makes (or reuses) user eval-publisher (Dana Reyes) with the Publisher role and sends three clicks through campaign B's direct link carrying her t202pubid (a rerun adds three more)
setup: uid=$(p202 user list --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.user_name=="eval-publisher") | .user_id' | head -1); [ -n "$uid" ] || uid=$(p202 user create --user-name eval-publisher --user-email eval-publisher@example.com --user-pass eval-publisher-pass-1 --user-fname Dana --user-lname Reyes -q); p202 user role assign "$uid" 6 --json >/dev/null 2>&1; pub=$(p202 user get "$uid" --json | jq -r '.data.user_public_publisher_id') && c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name=="EVAL Campaign B") | .aff_campaign_id' | head -1) && t=$(p202 tracker list --all --json | jq -r --arg c "$c" '[.data[] | select((.aff_campaign_id|tostring)==$c and (.rotator_id|tostring)=="0" and (.landing_page_id|tostring)=="0")][0].tracker_id') && url=$(p202 tracker get-url "$t" --json | jq -r '.data.direct_url') && for i in 1 2 3; do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36' "$url&t202kw=partner%20newsletter&t202pubid=$pub"; done && origin=$(printf '%s' "$url" | sed 's#^\(https\{0,1\}://[^/]*\).*#\1#') && curl -sS -o /dev/null "$origin/202-cronjobs/dej.php"
cases.ask: Which publisher's links sent the most clicks, all time, and how many clicks was that?

checks.run: p202 report breakdown --breakdown publisher --period alltime --json | jq '[.data[] | select(.name == "Dana Reyes" and (.total_clicks | tonumber) >= 3)] | length == 1'

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply names Dana Reyes with the click count a breakdown by publisher over all time reads for her. FAIL if it reports the account's total clicks or a campaign's as hers, counts by traffic source or user list instead of the publisher breakdown, or invents a number without reading.

cases.notes: Analyze › Publishers on the CLI: clicks are credited to the publisher whose link (t202pubid) they came on, and `publisher` is a report dimension. Before it an agent could list users with the Publisher role and had no way to say what their links did.

cases.ask: How many clicks did each of Dana Reyes's publisher links get, all time? Name each link by its t202id.

checks.run: uid=$(p202 user list --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.user_name=="eval-publisher") | .user_id' | head -1); c=$(p202 campaign list --all --json | jq -r '.data[] | select(.aff_campaign_name=="EVAL Campaign B") | .aff_campaign_id' | head -1); pubid=$(p202 tracker list --all --json | jq -r --arg c "$c" '[.data[] | select((.aff_campaign_id|tostring)==$c and (.rotator_id|tostring)=="0" and (.landing_page_id|tostring)=="0")][0].tracker_id_public'); p202 report breakdown --breakdown publisher_link --publisher-id "$uid" --period alltime --json | jq --arg t "$pubid" '[.data[] | select(.name == $t and (.total_clicks | tonumber) >= 3)] | length == 1'

expected.rubric: PASS if the reply gives the t202id of campaign B's direct link with the click count a breakdown by publisher_link narrowed to Dana Reyes (--publisher-id, her user id from the publisher breakdown or the user list) reads. FAIL if it gives a tracker's internal id as the t202id, lists every publisher's links as hers, or invents a number without reading.

cases.notes: The link a credited click came on is stored with it (its public id, the t202id in the link) and is the publisher_link dimension; --publisher-id narrows any report to one publisher.
